Any folder whose name starts with `mock` or `__mock` now counts as mock resources, whatever follows in its name. That covers a bare `mock/`, `mock.data/`, `mock(old)/`, `mock-größe/` and `mock模拟/`. The `codeanalyzer` test suite ran with no failures reported, but I didn't write tests for the new cases or run them separately.

The change is in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`, lines 393–394. I replaced the old character class `[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+` in the two patterns with `[^/]*`. The match stays inside one folder name, so `remock/`, `demo/`, `src/main/java/`, `mock.java` and `mockery.java` are still not test code. The old folders (`mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/`, `mockStore/`) still match, since `[^/]*` accepts everything the old class did.

Backslash paths already work. `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` tries the pattern against the path with `\` converted to `/`, so I left it alone.
